ruleDefinitions.name: PUA - NPS Tunneling Tool Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of NPS, a port forwarding and intranet penetration proxy server

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\npc\\\.exe$") OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-server\\=.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-vkey\\=.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-password\\=.*")) OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-config\\=npc.*") OR (process_hash = RGX(".*MD5\\=AE8ACF66BFE3A44148964048B826D005.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*SHA1\\=CEA49E9B9B67F3A13AD0BE1C2655293EA3C18181.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*SHA256\\=5A456283392FFCEEEACA3D3426C306EB470304637520D72FED1CC1FEBBBD6856.*")))
